title: "Reference Library"
citation: false
format:
  html: default
---

The following references have been compiled to provide an overview of the data, methods, and guidance associated with the Analytics Engine. These external references offer detailed insights into how datasets were compiled and how methodologies were designed, and form the backbone of the Analytics Engine's climate data tools.

For the latest memorandums on the datasets and methodology behind the Analytics Engine, please visit the [Climate Data and Analysis Working Group (C-DAWG) page](https://www.energy.ca.gov/programs-and-topics/topics/research-and-development/climate-data-and-analysis-working-group-c-dawg).

```{=html}
<script>
$(document).ready(function () {
  (function (data) {

      var activeTopics = new Set();
      var filterBtn = document.getElementById('topic-filter-btn');
      var filterBtnLabel = document.getElementById('topic-filter-btn-label');

      function updateFilterButtonLabel() {
        filterBtnLabel.textContent = activeTopics.size === 0
          ? 'Filter by topic'
          : 'Filter by topic (' + activeTopics.size + ')';
      }

      // Close the dropdown when the cursor leaves it, instead of requiring
      // another click on the button.
      filterBtn.closest('.dropdown').addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
        var instance = bootstrap.Dropdown.getInstance(filterBtn);
        if (instance) instance.hide();
      });

      // Populate topic filter checkboxes (multi-select, OR'd together). A
      // reference can carry more than one topic, so flatten before taking
      // unique values.
      var topics = [...new Set(data.flatMap(function (d) { return d.categories; }))].sort();
      var menu = document.getElementById('topic-filter-menu');
      topics.forEach(function (t, i) {
        var id = 'topic-filter-' + i;
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        li.innerHTML = '<div class="form-check px-2">'
          + '<input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" value="' + t + '" id="' + id + '">'
          + '<label class="form-check-label" for="' + id + '">' + t + '</label>'
          + '</div>';
        menu.appendChild(li);
      });

      // Initialize DataTable
      var table = $('#references-table').DataTable({
        data: data,
        ordering: false,
        columns: [
          {
            data: 'categories',
            width: '16%',
            render: function (data) {
              return data.join(', ');
            }
          },
          {
            data: 'description',
            width: '74%',
            render: function (data, type, row) {
              if (type === 'display') {
                return '<div class="ref-description">' + data + '</div>'
                  + '<small class="ref-citation text-muted">' + row.citation + '</small>';
              }
              return data + ' ' + row.citation;
            }
          },
          {
            data: 'link',
            width: '10%',
            render: function (data, type, row) {
              if (!data) return '';
              var icon = row.isPdf ? 'bi-file-earmark-pdf-fill' : 'bi-link-45deg';
              var label = row.isPdf ? 'View' : 'Link';
              return '<a href="' + data + '" target="_blank" '
                + 'class="btn btn-sm ref-link-btn">'
                + '<i class="bi ' + icon + ' me-1"></i>' + label + '</a>';
            }
          }
        ],
        paging: false,
        lengthChange: false,
        scrollY: '80vh',
        scrollCollapse: true,
        language: {
          search: 'Search:'
        },
        createdRow: function (row, rowData) {
          if (rowData.categories.indexOf('Cal-Adapt') !== -1) {
            row.classList.add('cal-adapt-row');
          }
        }
      });

      // DataTables renders its own search box separately from the table;
      // move it into the same control row as the topic filter so they align.
      $('#table-controls').append($('#references-table_filter'));

      // Multiple topics can be active at once; a row matches if any of its
      // (possibly multiple) categories is in the active set
      $.fn.dataTable.ext.search.push(function (settings, searchData, index, rowData) {
        return activeTopics.size === 0
          || rowData.categories.some(function (c) { return activeTopics.has(c); });
      });

      menu.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
        var checkbox = e.target;
        if (checkbox.type !== 'checkbox') return;
        if (checkbox.checked) {
          activeTopics.add(checkbox.value);
        } else {
          activeTopics.delete(checkbox.value);
        }
        updateFilterButtonLabel();
        table.draw();
      });
  })(REFERENCES_DATA);
});
</script>
```
